thread:
maria: Heads-up — planning to cut over the autoscaling policy for the 'dedicated-us-west-1-a' GPU pool at 15:00 PT today. This is the v2.3 autoscale policy (improves burst handling + KV cache-aware batching). Will run canary, then promote if smoke looks good. ping @cheng for deploy, @alex for smoke. Link to runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/dedicated-pool-autoscale

cheng: SGTM. I can do the deploy. ETA 15:00 PT. I'll do a 5-node canary first (50% qps traffic routed). Will watch QPS/latency and token cost.

alex: I'll run the smoke suite and the perf window. Smoke checklist: quick health curl, run 100 short-gen requests, verify KV cache hit ratio stays >=0.65, and confirm no OOMs in logs. Command I'll use: `./scripts/smoke_gpu_pool.sh --pool dedicated-us-west-1-a --canary`

maria: Awesome. Smoke script also posts to #eng-oncall. Add `--trace` if you hit something flaky. Also we need rollback plan ready — keep v2.2 policy pinned and the `redwoodctl` rollback command available.

sarah: Noted. I'll watch Console dashboards and trigger traces if latency > 1200ms p50. Also make sure the autoscaler pods metric exporter is green.

cheng: Deploy started: initiating canary at 15:00:12 PT. Command: `redwoodctl policy apply --pool dedicated-us-west-1-a --policy autoscale-v2.3 --mode canary --replicas 5`

deploy-bot: Deploy event recorded — user=cheng, pool=dedicated-us-west-1-a, policy=autoscale-v2.3, mode=canary, ts=1912347615

alex: Running smoke now.
- health: `curl -sS https://internal-api.redwood/pools/dedicated-us-west-1-a/health | jq .` -> {"status":"ok","queues":3}
- load test: `./tools/loadgen -c 100 -p short-gen` -> 100 requests completed, 98 success, 2 timeouts (investigating)
- KV cache hit ratio (console): 0.68
- GPU mem: no OOMs, 72% avg usage

maria: Quick note — those 2 timeouts look like client retries, not OOM. Alex, can you paste the two payloads? Also check model fallback logs (shouldn't have happened).

alex: pasted payloads. Looks like backoff in client lib. No model fallback entries. p50/p95 latency: 210ms / 680ms. Token cost per request down ~5% (good).

cheng: Observability looks healthy. Increasing canary to 10 replicas and 75% traffic for another 10m to confirm stability. `redwoodctl policy update --pool dedicated-us-west-1-a --canary-scale 10 --traffic 75`

maria: OK from product/ops POV. If nothing blows up in 10m, promote to global. Rollback command if needed: `redwoodctl rollout rollback --pool dedicated-us-west-1-a --to-policy autoscale-v2.2` — who will execute if we need rollback?

cheng: I'll perform rollback if we see sustained p95 > 2s or error rate > 2% for 3m.

sarah: I'll set an alert for p95 > 1.5s and error rate > 1% with a 3m window. If it fires, I'll ping #eng-oncall and @cheng.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic increased — pool=dedicated-us-west-1-a, replicas=10, traffic=75%, ts=1912347668

alex: Running extended perf window. 500 requests over 5m. Results: success 497/500, p95=720ms, no OOMs, KV hit ratio steady 0.66.

maria: Sounds good. Proceed to promote to global at 15:20 PT unless anyone objects. Reminder: update the release note in the deploy doc and tag the policy in infra repo.

cheng: Promoting now: `redwoodctl policy promote --pool dedicated-us-west-1-a --policy autoscale-v2.3`

deploy-bot: Promotion complete — pool=dedicated-us-west-1-a, policy=autoscale-v2.3, ts=1912347710

sarah: Dashboards look green post-promote. No alerts.

maria: Great. Thanks all. Action items: (1) @cheng add commit to infra repo tagging v2.3, (2) @alex paste smoke logs to the runbook, (3) @sarah keep alert thresholds for 24h.

cheng: Will do.

alex: Logs uploaded to runbook.

sarah: Alerts on for 24h. No issues so far. :thumbsup:

maria: Closing thread. If anything crops up, re-open here or page oncall. Thanks!
